title: Design a Messaging/Chat System
prompt: Design a one-on-one and group chat system like WhatsApp or Slack — users can send messages that are delivered in near real time, and message history is available when a user comes back online.
requirements: Functional: 1:1 and group messaging, delivery to online users in near real time, offline users get messages when they reconnect, message history/search
Non-functional: hundreds of millions of daily active users, low delivery latency, messages should not be lost, ordering should be reasonable within a conversation
discussion_points: Real-time delivery mechanism (long polling, WebSockets, push notifications) and connection management at scale
How to route a message to the right server when a recipient's connection lives on a different server
Storage model for message history (and how it supports pagination/search)
Handling offline delivery and message ordering/deduplication
Group chat fan-out: pushing to every member vs a pull model
Read receipts / delivery status without heavy write amplification
